tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Current retail fuel prices for all API-supported countries. Supports the same price keys as /api/fuel/prices, including gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG, E85, kerosene and grade variants. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list.

tools.name: compare_fuel_prices
tools.description: Compare current prices for one fuel type across 2-10 countries. Returns sorted table cheapest-first.

tools.name: find_cheapest_fuel
tools.description: Find the cheapest countries for a given fuel type in a region (or worldwide). Useful for route planning.

tools.name: get_vansky_weather
tools.description: Get VanSky vanlife weather suitability score (0-100) for a country: van_score, sleep_score, solar yield, driving conditions, awning safety, condensation risk, 7-day forecast.

tools.name: list_vansky_top
tools.description: List the top N countries with the highest VanSky van-travel suitability score today.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List vanlife events: expos (Caravan Salon), festivals, meetups, forums, road trips. Filter by status, type, country, or free-text search.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get full details for a single vanlife event by its slug.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search aggregated vanlife news stories (7 languages, 400+ sources). Filter by search query, category, country, locale.

tools.name: compare_vanbasket
tools.description: Compare food price index between two countries (world average = 100). Higher number = more expensive food.

tools.name: get_vanbasket
tools.description: Get VanBasket food price index details for one country.

tools.name: get_currency_rate
tools.description: Convert an amount between two currencies using live rates (150+ currencies, daily updates).

tools.name: check_visa_rules
tools.description: Entry rules for one passport and destination: entry mode, allowed length of stay, how the days are counted (per entry or in a rolling window), whether a visa run resets the counter, and temporary vehicle import. Answers carry a confidence level and source — pass those on instead of stating a rule as

tools.name: get_route_visa_rules
tools.description: Visa rules for every country of a route in one call, for up to 10 passports at once, plus the tightest leg of the route.

tools.name: get_vehicle_import_rules
tools.description: Temporary admission rules for a foreign-plated vehicle in one country: allowed days, per entry or per window, carnet requirement, green card. A country without a rule we can stand behind returns nothing rather than a guess.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_fuel_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current retail fuel prices (gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG) for 125+ countries. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list." → after: "Current retail fuel prices for all API-supported countries. Supports the same price keys as /api/fuel/prices, including gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG, E85, kerosene and grade variants. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
